frameworks.name: 10-Stage Roadmap to 100M+
frameworks.definition: A structured progression through ten predictable growth stages for scaling businesses, characterized by headcount transitions and changing constraints across eight business functions.

claims.text: The mental energy and effort spent on envy for others' achievements could be redirected toward personal development; comparing yourself to others achieves nothing because their success does not change your reality.
claims.speaker: Alex Hormozi

claims.text: Winning occurs through growing into your potential and allowing underperformers to become irrelevant by consequence, not by directly beating competitors.
claims.speaker: Alex Hormozi
claims.mechanism: Growth into potential compounds relative advantage; competition with others is a zero-sum mental model that misallocates effort.

claims.text: A mediocre version of yourself that never realized your potential poses a greater threat to success than any external competitor.
claims.speaker: Alex Hormozi
claims.mechanism: External competition is only relevant if internal potential is maximized; failure to develop oneself creates a ceiling that no external factor can overcome.

claims.text: People who get copied the most by competitors are the ones who ignore the competition copying them because they focus on solving customer problems, which drives universal imitation.
claims.speaker: Alex Hormozi
claims.mechanism: Focusing on customer outcomes produces the tactics and results that work; others copy because the work is objectively effective, not because they are being watched.
bounded_by: Assumes competitors exist and are worth copying

claims.text: Redirecting mental effort from tearing down others toward self-improvement compounds into greater results than any energy spent on comparison or criticism.
claims.speaker: Alex Hormozi
claims.mechanism: Only one of these uses of energy—proofing yourself or tearing others down—helps you; the former creates internal value, the latter dissipates energy.

claims.text: Hormozi has built and scaled multiple companies through different business models (software, physical products, service businesses, brick-and-mortar) and has completed the 10-stage scaling roadmap to $100M+ revenue multiple times, validating the roadmap's universality.
claims.speaker: Alex Hormozi

numbers.axis: Revenue milestone and business model diversity

practices.text: Focus on the customer first rather than analyzing what competitors are doing.
Redirect mental effort from comparing yourself to others toward proving yourself capable and worthy.
Download and follow the free 10-stage roadmap (available at acquisition.com/roadmap) to understand the stages your business must progress through.
